name: Plague Carrier
body:
Source Ultimate Magic pg. 231
School necromancy [disease, evil]; Level arcanist 5, cleric 4, druid 4, hunter 4, oracle 4, sorcerer 5, warpriest 4, witch 5, wizard 5
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S
Effect
Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Fortitude negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes
Description
The target’s natural attacks carry filth fever (DC 10 + 1/2 of the creature’s Hit Dice + creature’s Con modifier).
